entries.applicability: Not an exact-group proof; H1 differs, and all positive time covers differ by DEDUCTIONS.md. Candidate must be credited as related earlier work.

entries.publication: Michigan Math. J. 73(3),621–630 (2023); author list dates July 1,2023
entries.result: Geometric CAT(0) 2-complex actions for symmetric/palindromic families; cubulation is left as a question.
entries.applicability: Even a matching CAT(0)-space theorem is weaker than requested. The target is not palindromic on the displayed basis; no claim is made that a different basis cannot make it palindromic, since mod2 comparison alone would not prove that.

entries.result: Train-track and CAT(0)-space family framework; latest change described by arXiv as an acknowledgement-name change.
entries.applicability: No exact-target geometric cubulation located; later thesis version still distinguishes the CAT(0) 2-complexes from cubical structures.

entries.result: Fast monodromies admit free CAT(0) cube actions; geometric strengthening is asked for and outlined as a strategy.
entries.applicability: Target has quadratic growth and rank3, so fast corollary applies. It does not assert properness or cocompactness. Original unrestricted theorem superseded after recorded gap.
Target fastness supplies unbranching through HW; quasicubical is not an equivariant geometric action. Example9.1 uses ba,cb and has torsion-free H1, unlike target.

entries.result: CAT(0), virtual specialness and virtual cocompactness classification for a linear one-vertex tubular family.
entries.applicability: Displayed rank3 family has free H1 rank at least3 versus target2; target top generator is modified by b and has quadratic growth. Introduction example contains an apparent c/b typo; general family and Example4.11 used for scope, not silently corrected.

entries.result: Subgroup completion/local-isometry algorithm for an already NPC cube complex; finite termination when finitely generated subgroup is convex cocompact.
entries.applicability: Established method closely related to proposed compact cyclic Q. It neither constructs the target group cube action nor makes cyclic convex-cocompactness automatic; new-method claims are unwarranted.

entries.result: Metric Kan–Thurston construction and foundational flag-link results.
entries.applicability: Generic flag-link verification is prior standard theory. Main construction replaces the group via homology data and does not identify a geometric action of this G.

entries.publication: Groups St Andrews1997 in Bath, pp512–516 (1999); arXiv2012 record
entries.result: Cube/Morse constructions yielding F3-by-Z examples with nonfree locally free subgroups.
entries.applicability: Current exact Proposition1 uses inverse final a; H1 is torsion-free Z2, whereas target has Z/2 torsion. Nearby words and rank3 alone do not identify target.

entries.result: Coarse obstructions and tubular coarse-median characterization; cites later Wu–Ye distinction.
entries.applicability: Obstruction/classification input does not itself yield the requested target action; no exact example found in full-text targeted checks.

entries.result: CAT(0)-space action for a one-sided triangular monodromy with nonzero relevant exponent sum.
entries.applicability: Conclusion lacks cube structure. Exact original target not supplied as a named theorem; no isomorphism from that displayed monodromy asserted.
